changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Route broad yearly finance summary questions to executable ADS finance templates instead of generic datasource-free agent workflow.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template (template_code, domain, role_hint, intent_patterns, question_samples, sql_template, parameters, target_view, description, priority, is_active) VALUES ('TPL-56', 'finance', NULL, '[".*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(财务|收款|回款|应收|实收).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览).*",".*(财务|收款|回款|应收|实收).*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览).*"]', '["2026年财务数据统计下","看下2026年财务数据统计","今年财务数据汇总"]', $tpl$ WITH settlement AS ( SELECT f."业务月份" AS "财务月份", COUNT(DISTINCT f."项目") AS "结算项目数", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(f."应收折前" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "应收折前", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(f."折后实收" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "折后实收", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(f."已回款" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "已回款", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(f."未回款" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "未回款", ROUND(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(f."回款进度" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 4) AS "平均回款进度" FROM public.xycyl_ads_finance_month_settlement f WHERE f."业务月份" LIKE CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-%' GROUP BY f."业务月份" ), collection AS ( SELECT c."收款月份" AS "财务月份", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(c."收款金额" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "收款金额", ROUND(SUM(CAST(NULLIF(CAST(c."收款单数" AS VARCHAR), '') AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) AS "收款单数", COUNT(DISTINCT c."项目") AS "收款项目数" FROM public.xycyl_ads_finance_collection c WHERE c."收款月份" LIKE CAST(:year AS VARCHAR) || '-%' GROUP BY c."收款月份" ) SELECT COALESCE(s."财务月份", c."财务月份") AS "财务月份", COALESCE(s."结算项目数", 0) AS "结算项目数", COALESCE(s."应收折前", 0) AS "应收折前", COALESCE(s."折后实收", 0) AS "折后实收", COALESCE(s."已回款", 0) AS "已回款", COALESCE(s."未回款", 0) AS "未回款", COALESCE(s."平均回款进度", 0) AS "平均回款进度", COALESCE(c."收款金额", 0) AS "收款金额", COALESCE(c."收款单数", 0) AS "收款单数", COALESCE(c."收款项目数", 0) AS "收款项目数" FROM settlement s FULL OUTER JOIN collection c ON s."财务月份" = c."财务月份" ORDER BY "财务月份" $tpl$, '{"year":{"type":"integer","required":true}}', 'public.xycyl_ads_finance_month_settlement', '年度财务数据统计', 40, true) ON CONFLICT (template_code) DO UPDATE SET domain = EXCLUDED.domain, role_hint = EXCLUDED.role_hint, intent_patterns = EXCLUDED.intent_patterns, question_samples = EXCLUDED.question_samples, sql_template = EXCLUDED.sql_template, parameters = EXCLUDED.parameters, target_view = EXCLUDED.target_view, description = EXCLUDED.description, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, updated_at = now();
